verdicts.title: Duplicated per-platform CDLL-loading block in _load_lib_with_handle and load_lib_path
verdicts.reasoning: Read both functions in numbox/core/bindings/utils.py. Lines 159-164 (_load_lib_with_handle) and lines 178-183 (load_lib_path) are character-for-character identical: both test `platform_ in ("Darwin", "Linux")` and return `CDLL(path, mode=RTLD_GLOBAL)`, both test `platform_ == "Windows"` and return `CDLL(path, winmode=0)`, and both raise `RuntimeError(f"Platform {platform_} is not supported, yet.")`. The variable name passed to CDLL is `path` in both cases (no difference). The claim that a future platform or RTLD flag change must be applied in two places is accurate. The duplication is real and the desync hazard is genuine, though low-severity given the code's current stability.
